reviews.text:
Thank you to Isabelle, it was a very enriching afternoon full of learning and advice.
Thank you again for your teaching skills and your love for our animals.

Isabelle came to my home and spent over three hours teaching me the basics of living in harmony with my dog ​​(she's my first dog). It's up to me to do the exercises every day, because regular practice is necessary and essential if you want to see results... (without it, Isabelle's dedication and all her advice will be wasted). Isabelle's report after the session is very helpful and makes it easy to remember her advice. In short, as you can see, it's a partnership, but it's well worth it.

Thank you so much for your feedback and your trust!

I was delighted to share this training session with Baïko and your whole family. I appreciated everyone's involvement and receptiveness during our meeting, which is a real asset for the future.

Progress will come naturally by remaining consistent and regular, and above all, by everyone speaking the same language to Baïko every day. Consistency from the whole family is one of the keys to the success of his training, and he was very receptive during this session.

I wish you many wonderful moments with him and, of course, remain available. Please don't hesitate to give me updates or contact me if you have any questions.

See you soon!

Fantastic experience! Isabelle came to my home for four hours to help me with my dogs' barking when they're left alone, and it was a real game-changer. She took the time to explain and demonstrate exactly what to do, and the results were incredibly fast. Beyond simply solving the problem, she truly helped me change my perspective on and management of my dogs, and now everything is much more peaceful. I recommend her 100%, without hesitation!
I highly recommend it! Thank you Isabelle for this very informative 3-hour session and for all your valuable advice!

A huge thank you to Isabelle for her insightful and personalized advice during her home visit. We contacted her as soon as our Australian Shepherd, Azko, arrived, as we wanted the right tools for his training. She immediately understood our dog and also our behavioral mistakes… and no, you don't train a puppy the same way you raise a baby. She also provides ongoing support. Thank you so much.

A fantastic 4-hour session with lots of discussion, advice, and specific exercises to perform.
After just one week, there are already noticeable signs of a change in my dog's behavior.
Thank you, Isabelle.
Very professional, good advice, I highly recommend her

I contacted Isabelle as soon as we adopted our 5-month-old puppy, Naya. In just one session, we received all the theoretical instructions and practical exercises to train our little girl. It's very important that the whole family, including the children, be present so we can do the same thing and use the same language.

I contacted Isabelle again after six months because I wanted to take my dog's training further to ensure reliable recall in all situations (🐈).
Isabelle gives excellent advice and has a perfect understanding of dogs. I also recommend buying the kibble she sells; it's very well-balanced, and in just one month, my dog's coat became soft, strong, and shiny—a joy to cuddle.

I am truly delighted with Isabelle's visit to my home (nearly 4 hours!) to help me understand my 8-month-old Australian Shepherd. Her experience, knowledge, and clarity have given me confidence in myself and my dog. I can now make progress with his training and watch our bond grow stronger.
The detailed feedback I received the very next day allowed me to review what was discussed and done.

Christine

I had a 3-hour session with Isabelle for my puppy Rio and I loved it! 🐾
Isabelle is passionate, caring, and incredibly professional. She really takes the time to explain things thoroughly, with lots of concrete examples and great tips. I left feeling reassured, motivated, and better prepared to understand and support Rio. I recommend her 100%!

In three hours, Isabelle gave us all the tools we needed.

During the visit, Vania made tremendous progress, and thanks to the exercises, he's improving every day.
I'm so glad I contacted Isabelle.

Isabelle is very professional and offers excellent advice. She's truly passionate.
Lucky enjoyed learning about your approach. …
Great experience, Isabelle was great, I highly recommend it

Thank you Isabelle for the great advice, now it's my turn to put it into practice. So glad to have finally met a behaviorist... a real one.
Thank you to Isabelle, a truly passionate person who dedicates countless hours to your dog. …
Isabelle is great, thank you for your advice.
